positioning: Data scientist and ML engineer at TU Dortmund. Takes ideas out of research papers and turns them into systems that run on real, messy data — measured honestly, and holding up outside the notebook. Background spans audio classification, simulation-based inference, recommendation systems in production, and causal inference, moving comfortably between research and the engineering that carries it.

availability: Available from October 2026, up to 20 hours/week during the semester and full-time during the semester break; based in Dortmund.

bullets: Developed and maintained R packages using version control, automated unit testing, and structured documentation.
Extended a causal decision tree R package by integrating custom median-based split rules (MAD, LSD) to handle noisy data.
Built an interactive web application to streamline the package's workflows and visualize model outputs.
Built a recommendation system in Python using a KD Tree-based similarity search over 50,000+ user-item interactions, applying tree/graph data structures to scale neighbour queries.
Improved user engagement by 15% and reduced computational complexity from O(n^2) to O(n log n) through algorithmic redesign.
Deployed and benchmarked the model on AWS, reducing processing time by 20% and establishing a reproducible inference pipeline.

projects.title: Master's Case Study: Bird Classification with Deep Learning
bullets: Built an end-to-end ConvNeXT-based deep learning pipeline in PyTorch for multi-label species classification from raw field-recording audio.
Benchmarked and ensembled CNN architectures with hyperparameter tuning, reaching 0.880 AUC-ROC on multi-label soundscapes.

projects.title: Estimating Cosmological Parameters from Power Spectrum
bullets: Built an amortized neural posterior estimation pipeline with BayesFlow to recover cosmological parameters (H0, Omega_m, n_s) from the noisy galaxy power spectrum using a sequence model and normalising flows.
Evaluated whether the learned model's outputs could be trusted using SBC, contraction, z-score, and NRMSE diagnostics, not just whether they looked plausible.

projects.title: Wellbore Geology Prediction
bullets: Built a workflow to predict true vertical thickness from directional-survey and well-log data, with geometry-aware feature engineering using DTW, beam-search alignment, and formation-plane nearest-neighbour methods.
Trained a checkpointed LightGBM/XGBoost/CatBoost ensemble and reached an RMSE of 16.70

projects.title: Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving
bullets: Built a decoder-free RSSM (recurrent state-space model) world model with a 32x32 latent space, combining sequence modelling with a graph attention network (GAT) road representation for self-supervised trajectory prediction on raw, unlabeled GPS data.
Benchmarked the learned representation against a classical geometric (HMM/Viterbi) baseline to isolate what the self-supervised signal actually contributed, reaching 86.8% matching accuracy.

projects.title: Retrieval-Augmented Document Generation Service
bullets: Built and deployed a containerised LLM service on an Azure Linux VM that generates tailored, professionally formatted documents from unstructured source text, with a five-model Gemini chain and multi-provider OpenRouter fallback for availability.

Cut hallucinated formatting to zero by splitting the LLM to schema-constrained JSON content only and rendering deterministically in code; a tag-indexed entity store scores and retrieves the most relevant records per request.

Added a scheduled ingestion pipeline (GitHub Actions) aggregating records from public REST APIs, deduplicating against persisted state and ranking them with a bilingual German/English relevance filter that sharply cut false positives.
